page_title: LIV 1-1 MCI | Liverpool v Manchester City 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Michael Oliver is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' The resulting corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+9' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+8' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Liverpool win a corner.
90+7' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+5' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
90+4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+2' Liverpool failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Liverpool get a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Stefan Ortega.
89' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
85' The game is interrupted now, Kyle Walker (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

84' Ambitious effort from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
83' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
83' Andrew Robertson sends the ball into the centre of the box from the corner. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) bursts through a crowd of players but heads the ball miles wide of the left post.
82' The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
82' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
80' Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Stefan Ortega has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
76' Substitution. Darwin Nunez makes way for Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
74' Phil Foden (Manchester City) places a close-range header from a rebound onto the crossbar!
74' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Caoimhin Kelleher intercepts the ball.
71' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save.
69' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Julian Alvarez and he is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
69' Substitution. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) in, Kevin De Bruyne out.
69' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
66' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

66' A snap shot by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Stefan Ortega produces a good save to thwart him. The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
65' The ball rebounds back to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) on the edge of the box and he produces another shot, just to see it fly wide of the target.
65' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
65' The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.

65' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
63' Good chance! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
61' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) replaces Conor Bradley.
61' Substitution. Dominik Szoboszlai leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool).
59' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) for a tough tackle.
58' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) sends a low pass into the box, towards Luis Diaz. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.

57' Phil Foden (Manchester City) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Caoimhin Kelleher to get hold of the ball.
56' Pep Guardiola is forced to make a change. Ederson (Manchester City) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Stefan Ortega.
54' Ederson (Manchester City) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), who has already been caught several times today.
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ederson into left side of the goal.
50' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
50' Ederson (Manchester City) is able to continue to play.
49' Ederson (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' A yellow card for a tackle by Ederson (Manchester City). Michael Oliver doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

47' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Ederson (Manchester City) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a penalty! Liverpool have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
46' One of the Liverpool players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
46' The whistle blows and Michael Oliver starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) produces a mid-range free kick and sends a daisy-cutter towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a good save and stops his effort.
45+2' Today's referee Michael Oliver rightly decides to book Rodri (Manchester City) for his harsh tackle. Liverpool win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
45+2' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
45+1' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
43' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece.
42' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
40' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is caught offside!
39' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Caoimhin Kelleher is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
39' An attempted cross from Conor Bradley (Liverpool) is cleared.
39' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
37' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
37' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Manchester City have a corner.
35' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
35' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
34' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
32' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) climbs all over the defender near the penalty spot to win the ball from a cross by Harvey Elliott, but plants his header narrowly wide of the right post.
31' The Liverpool players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
29' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
28' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
27' The linesman raises his flag. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.

23' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Kevin De Bruyne delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where John Stones (Manchester City) is lurking. His precise shot from close range goes straight inside the right post and it's 0:1.
23' Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
23' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
22' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
21' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is flagged for offside.
20' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
19' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) has a goal ruled out for offside!
18' Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul after Kyle Walker (Manchester City) hacks down one of his opponents.
18' Phil Foden (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
16' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
16' Flag goes up against Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
14' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
12' Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
10' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared.
10' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Manchester City earn a corner.
9' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
8' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
6' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) jumps into a tackle and Michael Oliver signals a foul.
5' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

3' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off a comfortable save.
